2034-3490-6824-8333.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-6824-8333.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

539-1247-7008.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

277-4094-4365-7824-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-4094-4365-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

6798-7940--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat

765-2034-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

3129-4682-7890.notablePrerequisites: At least two opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
3129-4682-7890.description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing two opponents to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens due to Primal Vigor
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have near-infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat the loop targeting yourself as one of the players in step 1, drawing any number of cards.

628-2034-7865.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3179-4399-4476-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Answered Prayers trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Answered Prayers trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4476-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

670-1619-4142-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6135.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Aarakocra Sneak to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-4053-5434-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4053-5434-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4053-5434-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

457-1458-4404-6747.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
You control an artifact.
457-1458-4404-6747.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Sami.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-2049-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-2049-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2301-5231-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2301-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Abzan Ascendancy and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1171-1409-6633.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

1525-6913-6986-7115-7117.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland card in hand.
You have not resolved either a firebending ability, a waterbending ability, and/or an airbending ability this turn.
1525-6913-6986-7115-7117.description:
Cast any spell by paying {0} due to Leyline of Mutation and Aang, Master of Elements.
Toph triggers, earthbending a land.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card and put it into your hand due to Abundance.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1, and repeat from step 1 as able.
1525-6913-6986-7115-7117.notes: You need to have both an Avatar Aang and an Aang, Master of Elements on the battlefield. This combo only reduces the mana cost of spells to {0} - it doesn't negate additional costs or targets those spells may require.

1336-1781-1978.description:
Cause Heronblade Elite to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat from step 2.

67-1676-5670-5708-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-5670-5708-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Reveillark trigger, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it and Boss's Chauffeur trigger, causing you to mill three cards and put a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen.
When the Citizen dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it.
When Seedship Broodtender dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender ability, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
67-1676-5670-5708-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana and infinite creature tokens.

24-4090-5759.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Screaming Nemesis instead of you due to Pariah if you chose the largest number.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-4090-5759.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

2173-4699-4771-5220.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1274-4186-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4186-4268.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

804-2533-5963.description:
Activate Marvin by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Loyal Retainers.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by sacrificing it, returning Marvin from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Loyal Retainers.
Repeat.

222-527-4885-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-4885-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3293-5256-5282.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
3293-5256-5282.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Wormfang Newt.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Wormfang Newt's power.
Repeat.

3129-3490-3910-4017-5296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
3129-3490-3910-4017-5296.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting ten +1/+1 counters on Workhorse
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Boonweaver Giant

891-1353-2719-4050-5214.notablePrerequisites: Next of Kin attached to Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
891-1353-2719-4050-5214.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sakashima, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to put Sakashima into the command zone from your graveyard.
Next of Kin triggers, putting Sakashima from the command zone onto the battlefield as a copy of Boonweaver Giant.
Sakashima enters the battlefield, returning Next of Kin from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sakashima.
Repeat.

1651-2645-3272-4231-4659.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and Clock of Omens, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Cave Entrance room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and Staff of Domination, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Mine Tunnels room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, and create a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and the Food token, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Dark Pool room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and the Clue token, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Temple of Dumathoin room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing you to draw a card and complete Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and the Treasure token, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Cave Entrance room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificng an artifact token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

1624-2749.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you have one life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

618-813-957.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages with haste.
The token copy of Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Time Stretch and any second instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
